allowDelegateUnlock.label: Temporary unlock
allowDelegateUnlock.info:
Any app running as you can request password-free access for up to 60 seconds.
VGS cannot check that Jarvis made the request or that you approved it.
Turning this off ends active access.
VGS must keep running and responding. A crash can leave access open, and a stall can delay locking.
Sleep can extend access if Lock before sleep is off.

lock.label: Lock
lock.hint: Another lock screen can prevent VGS from locking the session

temporaryAccess.label: Temporary access
temporaryAccess.info:
Access lasts up to 60 seconds while VGS runs and responds.
The lock key, inactivity, sleep or turning off permission can end it sooner.
A crash can leave access open. A stall can delay locking.
Sleep can extend access if Lock before sleep is off.

requirements.purpose: Delays sleep while the session locks
Detects when the computer is about to sleep
Checks how long the computer can wait for the lock
Finds the theme's background image for the lock screen

binds.info:
Locks immediately and ends temporary access.
Use your password to unlock. Temporary unlock also permits password-free access requests.
